learning_outcomes.text: Acquire theoretical background for creating and developing new materials to address the energy challenges facing society.
Search for, analyze and synthesize data and information, using the necessary technology.

syllabus_topics: Carbon materials of different dimensionalities – present and next generation
Oxide materials and their application in energy research
Two-dimensional materials for energy production and storage
Perovskite based materials for solar cell
Novel materials for enhance battery performance
Materials For Li-ion and Beyond Li-ion Batteries

assessment_methods.method: Paper with oral presentation on a selected topic

bibliography: “Energy Materials: A short Introduction to Functional Materials for Energy and Conversion”, Aliaksandr S. Bandarenka 1st ed CRC Press, New York, 2021
“Materials for Energy”, Edited by Sam Zhang, 1st ed., CRC Press, New York, 2021.
“Batteries: Materials principles and characterization methods”, Edited by Chen Lia, IOP ebooks, 2022
Emerging Photovoltaic Material: Silicon & Beyond (Advanced Materials), edited by Santosh K. Kurinec, 1st ed. Wiley, Beverly, MA, 2018
degree: Materials Science and Engineering — Πτυχίο Τμήματος Επιστήμης και Μηχανικής Υλικών (first cycle, 240 ECTS, curriculum ΕΜΥ)
